performance.verdict: $592 spent, zero leads — Google funnel is broken, not underperforming.

findings.text: Lead drought confirmed: 124 Google Ads clicks and $591.94 spend over 28 days produced zero leads and zero GA4 conversions. Funnel or tracking is broken.
Overdue SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA flagged Done July 20 but no completed event recorded — verification status unknown as of Aug 28.
3-day spend signal (Aug 25–27: $19.58, $13.98, $19.69) vs prior 3 (Aug 22–24: $9.43, $13.47, $6.48) — spend is recovering, but 0 leads across all 28 days means recovery amplifies waste.
GBP generated 38 actions (37 direction requests, 0 calls) against 0 paid leads — local intent is real but the paid search funnel captures none of it.
GHL shows 135 opportunities created but 0 leads from ads and 0 appointments — opportunity source is unclear; pipeline data does not reconcile with paid channel output.

suggestions.text: Immediately audit Google Ads conversion action: 124 clicks, $591.94 spend, zero conversions — confirm pixel fires on thank-you page or call extension.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $591.94 across 28 days with 124 clicks and zero recorded conversions or leads — this is a tracking break or a landing page failure, not a performance issue. Audit the conversion action in Google Ads: confirm the pixel fires on the post-form thank-you page and that call extensions are recording. Success is defined as at least one confirmed conversion event firing within 72 hours of the fix. Resolve by 2026-08-31; if no conversion fires by then, pause spend on BWS - Search Campaign - Calls ($333.21 of the total) until the funnel is confirmed intact.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until F1 (zero conversions) is resolved; re-check 3-day signal on 2026-09-01.
